structure.unit: Crimes Against the Administration of Justice
Escape Of, Communications With and Deliveries to Prisoners

law.catch_line: Officers, etc., voluntarily allowing person convicted, charged, or adjudicated delinquent of felony to escape; penalty
law.text: If any sheriff, jailer, or other officer, or any guard or other person summoned or employed by any such sheriff, jailer, or other officer, voluntarily allows a prisoner or person committed to the Department of Juvenile Justice convicted of, charged with, or adjudicated delinquent of a felony to escape from his custody, he is guilty of a Class 4 felony.
